# New Beansland

Official public site: https://newbeansland.org/
Founder: Jamel Hawkins
Contact: founder@newbeansland.org

New Beansland is a connected creative world. Public rooms include Books, University, Clothing, NBL Kids, TV & Film, NBL Music Productions, Founder’s Office, and About.

Current public facts:
- NBL Clothing Co. is open. Current public clothing is available now. The Not So Small™ line and NBL Pride Collection are Coming Soon. Current NBL clothing and footwear, including NBL Sneakers, are available now by request.
- NBL Kids is an open New Beansland department led and designed by Shanique Washington. Current NBL Kids statement shirts are available; Not So Small™ remains Coming Soon.
- NBL University admissions information is available at https://newbeansland.org/university.html and the separate campus at https://nblschool.com/ . Some University checkout routes remain held or unwired; academic access requires verified student entitlement. Do not claim the school is open solely because tuition is listed.
- The City is Coming Soon. Its official trailer and soundtrack preview are public now.
- NBL Music Productions is the New Beansland music department, with free public listening and releases at https://newbeansland.org/studio/ . NBL Music Studios is the music-building name in the New Beansland campus artwork. NBL Studios is the separate film and video department.
- Beans is the New Beansland AI assistant, available with the same NBL account on the website and mobile app. NBL Messenger is the separate human-to-human messaging service, with no Beans credits spent on direct messages. Professor Grey™ / Virgo are protected University teaching services for eligible students; NBL Plus is a separate premium Beans offer that does not grant school access. Founder approval is required for canon, publishing, spending, and policy.
- The New Beansland Governing Maxims are a public behavior standard for Beans and NBL reasoning. Current maxims include: “You may stretch meaning. You may not counterfeit evidence.” “If a claim is mythic, label the room.” “No joke is allowed to become fake evidence.” “Let the joke breathe. Keep the receipts nearby.”
- Do not invent New Beansland rooms, staff, products, prices, or history.
- Do not treat private development material as public canon.

Retrieve public pages on newbeansland.org before answering as if a door is open.
